notes: Supplied by the strand brief as OpenAlex W7161091175 only. opencite lookup cannot resolve a bare OpenAlex work identifier, so it was resolved through the OpenAlex REST interface, curl https://api.openalex.org/works/W7161091175, which returned title 'NeuralBench: A Unifying Framework to Benchmark NeuroAI Models', publication_date 2026-05-08, type preprint, and primary_location landing_page_url https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.08495. OpenAlex reports no DOI, so doi is null. Author-list note: OpenAlex splits the tenth author into two entries, 'Mingfang' and 'Zhang'; the arXiv abs page prints 'Mingfang (Lucy) Zhang', so the card and the bib record a single author, Mingfang Zhang, giving fourteen authors rather than OpenAlex's fifteen. OpenAlex also gives 'Jarod Levy' where the abs page gives 'Jarod Levy' with an acute accent, 'Jarod Levy' rendered as Levy on the abs page; the accented form from the abs page is used. Licence read directly from the abs-license block on the arXiv abs page, which links http://arxiv.org/licenses/nonexclusive-distrib/1.0/ -- arXiv's default non-exclusive licence, conveying no third-party redistribution right. pdf_license is therefore unknown, redistribution_ok is false, and no PDF is committed. source.md is a markitdown conversion of the v1 PDF (https://arxiv.org/pdf/2605.08495, 1.38 MB, retrieved 2026-07-31), retained as internal research notes under fair use. md_quality is rough: the body is single-column and the prose describing splitting, metrics and the pretraining-overlap caveat came through cleanly and quotably, but Table 1 (tasks, datasets, channels, subjects, hours) shredded into fragments, the CLIP loss equation lost its structure, and Figures 3 to 5 are image-only. Figure 4 is where the per-task results and the per-panel split-strategy labels live; its caption survived and states the labelling convention, and the axis labels for the split type and example counts partially survived in the extraction, which is how the card can say which task families used which split. Individual per-task accuracy values from Figures 3 to 5 are not quoted on the card because they are not recoverable. EXTRACTION UPDATE 2026-08-01 -- source.md was regenerated with pymupdf4llm, which preserves markdown tables and inter-word spacing that the earlier markitdown conversion destroyed, and md_quality was reassessed against the new extraction as clean (was rough). The PDF used for that extraction is cached locally as source.local.pdf, which is gitignored and deliberately not committed because the licence forbids redistribution.
